title: Member of Technical Staff (Test Engineering)
jobDescription: <div class="job-post-container" style="position: relative; background-color: white; padding: 20px; max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; box-shadow: 0px 0px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); min-height: 500px; border: 5px solid #0037A5;"> <div style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 2; width: 200px; height: 300px; margin-top: 30px; opacity: 1; z-index: 1;"> </div> <div class="job-post-content" style="position: relative; z-index: 2;"> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;"><img style="max-width: 100%; float: left;" src="https://i.imgur.com/b9m4CJj.jpeg" alt="" width="92"></h1> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;"> </h1> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;"> </h1> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;">Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.</h1> <p style="text-align: center;">Lots of tech companies disrupt. But, many fail when they try to scale. We're different. CockroachDB makes it easier for companies to build and scale apps. This is how and why we're helping some of the most innovative companies on the planet. We tackle problems head-on and focus on solutions that create lasting impact. </p> <h3 style="text-align: center;">Because when our customers win, we all win. </h3> <p> </p> <hr> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h2> <p>Databases must keep going no matter what. At Cockroach Labs, quality is our number one feature. We are software engineers on a mission to push our product to new frontiers. Our work has a broad-reaching impact on the engineering organization of over 100 engineers who rely on our tools and methodology to ship a top-notch quality product.<br><br>Test Engineering is expanding our investment in next-generation test automation and bug-finding techniques, utilizing both randomized and deterministic testing. Note that this is not a QA/manual testing role; all Cockroach Labs engineers write tests and obsess about quality. Test Engineering is a cross-functional team that aims to enable and strengthen the engineering organization by emphasizing correctness and performance testing. <br><br>The work encompasses three primary focus areas: Test Infrastructure, Exploratory Testing, and Performance and Scalability. Speaking broadly, Test Infrastructure enables automated test execution, detection of performance regressions, fuzzing, and much more. Exploratory Testing enables new bug-finding techniques such as static and dynamic analysis, metamorphic testing, failure injection, and others. Performance and Scalability enables at-scale benchmarking.<br><br>Some examples of recent and future projects:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/master/pkg/cmd/roachtest/roachtestutil/mixedversion/README.md">Mixed version</a> framework utilizing<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/tree/master/pkg/cmd/roachtest#readme"> roachtest</a> and<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/tree/master/pkg/cmd/roachprod#readme"> roachprod</a></li> <li>Failure injection testing (e.g.,<a href="https://chaos-mesh.org/"> chaos-mesh</a>,<a href="https://github.com/CARV-ICS-FORTH/frisbee"> frisbee</a>)</li> <li>Next generation of<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/tree/master/pkg/cmd/roachtest"> roachtest</a> and<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/roachperf"> roachperf</a></li> <li>Parallelized automated microbenchmarks via<a href="https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/tree/master/pkg/cmd/roachprod-microbench#readme"> roachprod-bench</a></li> <li>Developing a static analysis framework for concurrency bugs</li> <li>Large-scale benchmarking and performance testing</li> <li>Automated flaky test detection and quarantining</li> </ul> <p>The ideal candidate will have worked with massively complex codebases and possesses broad experience in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and automated testing.</p> <h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop test strategies and methodologies.</li> <li>Build and scale test infrastructure.</li> <li>Build tools and frameworks to find bugs in complex distributed systems.</li> <li>Build static and dynamic analyzers.</li> <li>Perform at-scale cloud benchmarking.</li> <li>Prioritize and execute test suites that are representative of customers’ workloads.</li> <li>Rigorous validation habits and deep domain expertise applied to all AI-assisted output.</li> <li>A clear understanding of where AI can be safely integrated and where it introduces unacceptable risk.</li> <li>Final authority over everything that goes to production — AI assists your work; it does not replace your judgment.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Expectations</strong></h2> <p>In your first 30 days, you will become an integrated member of our engineering team. You’ll become familiar with our production systems, software development workflows, and the architectures of CockroachDB and CockroachDB Cloud. We believe that it’s essential for you to take the first month to get to know our technology and our company. You’ll work on a “starter project” to help you learn about a particular area and start to get the lay of the land.<br><br>After your first month, you will align with the team’s development objectives and own a medium-sized project to completion.<br><br>By the end of the third month, you will be a fully contributing member of the Test Engineering team. You will also have developed enough familiarity with our engineering processes to propose and scope future projects.</p> <h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience as a software engineer writing clean, idiomatic code.</li> <li>1+ years of hands-on experience with GCP or AWS.</li> <li>Experience with one of the following: Database or Distributed Systems Testing, Static Code analysis, Failure mode analysis.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills and a collaborative mindset.</li> <li>BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Team</strong></h2> <p><strong>Reporting to Stan Rosenberg - Director of Engineering</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong> Stan is an experienced engineering leader, having built and scaled high-performing engineering teams and distributed systems at high-tech startups. Prior, he worked as a software engineer and a researcher in formal methods. He holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Stevens Institute of Technology. In his free time, he enjoys exploring outdoors while dreaming about days when software works as reliably as a bridge.<br><br><strong>BabuSrithar - Site Lead, India </strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong> BabuSrithar is the Site Leader for India. He is responsible for our growth strategy and is a cultural champion in the region. He is passionate about building high-quality software products and lean teams by leveraging everyone's potential. He enjoys working with people and learning along the way. Before joining Cockroach Labs, BabuSrithar held senior leadership positions at companies like Nutanix, Clumio and recently he was VP of engineering at Apty where he led the engineering globally. When not at work, he enjoys his time with his 3-year-old and family.<br><br><strong>Isaac Wong - EVP of Engineering</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong> Isaac is responsible for the health of the engineering organization at Cockroach Labs. He partners closely with teams to ensure we have a balanced culture that promotes quality and innovation in pursuit of our goals. Before joining Cockroach Labs Isaac was in life sciences for 16 years with Medidata Solutions where he had a front row seat on the exciting ride from a 30 person startup to more than 2000 people worldwide. But the lure of distributed, resilient, and consistent SQL databases, along with the amazing technology and culture at Cockroach Labs proved too much. When not working he likes to draw, play the piano, and search NYC for cannolis with his wife and kids. </p> <hr> <p>Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at <a href="mailto:accessibility@cockroachlabs.com">accessibility@cockroachlabs.com</a>.</p> <p>Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.</p> <hr> <h1>Benefits</h1> <ul> <li>Medical Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Time Off</li> <li>Paid Parental Leave</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing Benefits</li> <li>Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Wellness Allowance</li> <li>Food Allowance </li> <li>Office Commute Reimbursement</li> <li>And more!</li> </ul> </div> </div>

title: Senior Partner Sales Manager, ISV & GSIs
jobDescription: <div class="job-post-container" style="position: relative; background-color: white; padding: 20px; max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; box-shadow: 0px 0px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); min-height: 500px; border: 5px solid #0037A5;"> <div style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 2; width: 200px; height: 300px; margin-top: 30px; opacity: 1; z-index: 1;"> </div> <div class="job-post-content" style="position: relative; z-index: 2;"> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;"><img style="max-width: 100%; float: left;" src="https://i.imgur.com/b9m4CJj.jpeg" alt="" width="92"></h1> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;"> </h1> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;"> </h1> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;">Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.</h1> <p style="text-align: center;">Lots of tech companies disrupt. But, many fail when they try to scale. We're different. CockroachDB makes it easier for companies to build and scale apps. This is how and why we're helping some of the most innovative companies on the planet. We tackle problems head-on and focus on solutions that create lasting impact. </p> <h3 style="text-align: center;">Because when our customers win, we all win. </h3> <p> </p> <hr> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h2> <p>We're looking for an experienced Senior Manager to lead our Independent Software Vendor (ISV), Global Systems Integrator (GSI), and Regional Systems Integrator (SI) partner sales initiatives across APAC. In this strategic position within the Alliances and Partnerships team, you'll be instrumental in expanding and strengthening our partner ecosystem across all three partner motions in APAC — with ISV partnerships as a priority. You will identify, recruit, and nurture high-impact partners while collaborating closely with sales, technical, and GTM stakeholders to generate revenue and pipeline.</p> <p>This role demands deep insight into ISV partner dynamics and SI partner engagement models, proven experience driving partner-led revenue across multiple partner types, and a passion for building long-term collaborative relationships. This position is based in India.</p> <h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2> <p><strong>Develop and Execute Multi-Partner Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <ul> <li>Define and execute a strategic roadmap for ISV, GSI, and Regional SI partnerships across the APAC region, aligned to broader business goals — with ISV partnerships as the foundational motion.</li> <li>Conduct proactive scouting and qualification of potential ISV partners that align with our strategic priorities and growth ambitions.</li> <li>Identify and engage GSI and Regional SI partners whose delivery capabilities, industry verticals, or customer footprint create meaningful pipeline acceleration alongside the ISV motion.</li> <li>Ensure ISV, GSI, and SI strategies are complementary — for example, facilitating ISV-SI co-delivery models and joint GTM plays where appropriate.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Develop Partner Relationships</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with ISV partners from onboarding through co-selling execution.</li> <li>Cultivate trusted relationships with GSI and Regional SI partners, understanding their practice-building priorities, client engagement models, and incentive structures.</li> <li>Guide ISV partners through integration, validation, and certification processes in collaboration with technical teams.</li> <li>Support GSI and Regional SI partners in developing CockroachDB capability, including enablement, solution development, and delivery readiness.</li> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor across all partner types, helping them navigate opportunities and optimise joint success.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Joint GTM and Growth Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Develop and monitor joint business plans, ensuring measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.</li> <li>Drive coordinated go-to-market initiatives that enhance partner visibility and deliver results.</li> <li>Facilitate three-way collaboration (ISV + SI + CockroachDB field teams) to create integrated solutions and accelerate enterprise deals.</li> <li>Act as a subject matter expert on ISV, GSI, and Regional SI partnerships for internal teams including Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <ul> <li>Ensure robust partner enablement and operational processes are in place across all partner types.</li> <li>Adapt partner management approaches to reflect the distinct operating models of ISVs (product-led, integration-centric) versus GSIs/Regional SIs (services-led, delivery-centric).</li> <li>Collaborate with global alliances counterparts to share insights, refine strategy, and adopt best practices across ISV and SI motions.</li> <li>Provide leadership and mentorship to partnership team members and contribute to team performance.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Work closely with field sales and regional stakeholders to integrate partner-led opportunities into broader sales plays.</li> <li>Partner with the technical and solutions architecture teams to support ISV integration programmes and SI practice development in parallel.</li> <li>Coordinate with the global GSI team to ensure regional engagement with major GSI accounts is strategically aligned and accelerates pipeline and revenue.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Have</strong> </h2> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in ISV partnerships, Global or Regional Systems Integrators, technology alliances, or related partner sales functions within SaaS or enterprise software.</li> <li>Proven experience managing multiple partner types — including ISVs and SIs — with a clear understanding of how their business models, incentives, and engagement approaches differ.</li> <li>Strong familiarity with APAC market dynamics and growing a partner ecosystem across diverse geographies, including how GSI and Regional SI footprints vary across markets such as India, Indonesia, Singapore and Southeast Asia.</li> <li>Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales quotas or driving significant revenue through ISV partnerships.</li> <li>Experience developing ISV-SI co-sell and co-deliver motions, including joint solution packaging, deal registration, and revenue attribution models.</li> <li>Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Ability to develop and execute strategic plans, analyse market trends, and identify new opportunities across ISV and SI partner segments.</li> <li>Knowledge of technology, applications, products/solutions, platforms, SaaS and how GSIs and Regional SIs build and monetise practices around them.</li> <li>Ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and build consensus across a matrixed organisation.</li> <li>Highly motivated, driven, and results-oriented with a strong desire to succeed.</li> <li>A demonstrated practice of integrating AI tools into your daily workflow to improve speed, quality, and decision-making.</li> <li>Fluency with AI across core tasks — research, drafting, analysis, planning — used as a default, not an exception.</li> <li>A continuous drive to experiment with and adopt better ways of working as tools evolve.</li> <li>Openness and ability to travel ~50%.</li> </ul> <hr> <p>Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at <a href="mailto:accessibility@cockroachlabs.com">accessibility@cockroachlabs.com</a>.</p> <p>Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.</p> <hr> <h1>Benefits</h1> <ul> <li>Stock Options</li> <li>Medical Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability Insurance</li> <li>Professional Development Funds</li> <li>Flexible Time Off</li> <li>Paid Holidays</li> <li>Paid Sick Days</li> <li>Paid Parental Leave</li> <li>Retirement Benefits</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing Benefits</li> <li>And more!</li> </ul> </div> </div>

title: Sr. Program Manager, R&D Operations
jobDescription: <div class="job-post-container" style="position: relative; background-color: white; padding: 20px; max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; box-shadow: 0px 0px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); min-height: 500px; border: 5px solid #0037A5;"> <div style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 2; width: 200px; height: 300px; margin-top: 30px; opacity: 1; z-index: 1;"> </div> <div class="job-post-content" style="position: relative; z-index: 2;"> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;"><img style="max-width: 100%; float: left;" src="https://i.imgur.com/b9m4CJj.jpeg" alt="" width="92"></h1> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;"> </h1> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;"> </h1> <h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 20px; text-align: center;">Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.</h1> <p style="text-align: center;">Lots of tech companies disrupt. But, many fail when they try to scale. We're different. CockroachDB makes it easier for companies to build and scale apps. This is how and why we're helping some of the most innovative companies on the planet. We tackle problems head-on and focus on solutions that create lasting impact. </p> <h3 style="text-align: center;">Because when our customers win, we all win. </h3> <p> </p> <hr> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h2> <p>We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager, FinOps to join our Research & Development Operations team, based in Bengaluru, India. This is a high-visibility opportunity to define and mature our FinOps capabilities at Cockroach Labs, building on foundational work already underway across our engineering organization and taking our cloud financial management to a new level of rigor, scale, and competitive advantage. You will sit at the intersection of Engineering, Finance, and Operations, responsible for driving cost transparency, surfacing savings opportunities, and ensuring cloud infrastructure spend is managed with discipline and accountability.</p> <p>Cockroach Labs operates a significant cloud infrastructure footprint to power CockroachDB Cloud and our internal engineering environments. As we scale, the ability to understand, attribute, and optimize that spend is critical to our financial health and margin profile. This role will own the FinOps program end-to-end: stewarding the tooling that tracks cloud costs, partnering with Engineering and Finance to embed cost accountability across the organization, and building the cost allocation models that feed margin analysis and executive reporting.</p> <p>R&D Operations plays a crucial role in enabling our organization to exceed customer expectations by shortening feedback loops and accelerating learning. By focusing on coordination and process effectiveness, R&D Operations minimizes friction and allows teams to concentrate on delivering high-quality products and services.</p> <h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own and evolve the FinOps tooling platform used to track, report on, and analyze cloud infrastructure costs across AWS, GCP, and other providers, ensuring the data is accurate, timely, and actionable.</li> <li>Establish and run the FinOps operating cadence, including regular cost reviews, budget-vs-actuals variance analysis, anomaly detection, and a living optimization backlog with owners, timelines, and dollar-value targets.</li> <li>Build and maintain cost allocation frameworks that attribute cloud spend to products, teams, and customer workloads to support COGS calculation, unit economics, and margin analysis in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Identify and prioritize cloud cost optimization opportunities, including rightsizing, committed use discounts (reserved instances/savings plans), idle resource cleanup, storage tiering, egress reduction, Kubernetes/container cost efficiency, and emerging AI and machine learning infrastructure costs such as GPU compute, model training pipelines, and inference workloads.</li> <li>Manage cloud budgets and forecasts in close partnership with Finance and Engineering leadership; explain variances, surface risks early, and drive corrective action before spend exceeds plan.</li> <li>Drive cost accountability across Engineering by establishing tagging and labeling standards, showback/chargeback models, and cost-aware development practices that embed FinOps into the engineering culture.</li> <li>Build executive-level dashboards and reporting to communicate cloud spend trends, savings realized, optimization pipeline, and forecast vs. actuals to senior leadership and the board.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Infrastructure, Procurement, and Finance to align cost reduction initiatives with platform roadmap priorities and business goals, without compromising service quality or engineering velocity.</li> <li>Define governance frameworks, best practices, and FinOps policies that can scale with the business, including vendor discount strategy, commitment management, and cloud budget governance.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Expectations</strong></h2> <p>In your first 30 days, you will orient yourself by conducting a thorough review of Cockroach Labs' cloud infrastructure footprint, existing FinOps tooling, and current state of cost attribution and tagging. You will meet with key stakeholders across R&D and Finance to understand how cloud spend is tracked today, where the gaps are, and what decisions are being made without the data they deserve. Working closely with Finance, you will kick off the design of a tagging hierarchy that will allow cloud infrastructure costs to be viewed and rolled up across the dimensions that matter most: by team, product, environment, and customer workload.</p> <p>By day 60, you will have finalized the tagging taxonomy with Finance sign-off and begun driving adoption and enforcement across Engineering. You will have established yourself as the SME on our FinOps tooling platform, leading the first internal training, handling configuration changes, and becoming the go-to resource for questions from budget owners and team leads. You will also have built and published the first cost optimization backlog, identifying the highest-value efficiency opportunities surfaced by the tool and beginning to execute on the most actionable of them.</p> <p>By day 90, you will have established yourself as the definitive expert on where Cockroach Labs' cloud spend is occurring, and why. You will have partnered with Finance and budget owners to put budgets in place by category, delivered the first quarterly cloud spend report to leadership, and helped teams build the dashboards and showback views they need to make cost-aware decisions. When anomalies or trends surface, you will be the person who can explain them to an engineer, a finance partner, or an executive, with clarity and confidence.</p> <h2><strong>You Have</strong> </h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in program management, cloud financial management, or a closely related field, with a proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives independently.</li> <li>Hands-on FinOps tooling experience: production-grade experience with a dedicated FinOps platform (specifically CloudZero, Vantage, or Finout) is required, in addition to proficiency with native CSP cost management tools (AWS Cost Explorer / Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing, Azure Cost Management).</li> <li>Strong financial acumen: practical experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost allocation methodologies including showback, chargeback, and COGS/margin attribution.</li> <li>Deep understanding of cloud pricing models: committed use discounts, reserved instances, savings plans, spot/preemptible pricing, data egress costs, storage tiers, and managed service pricing across major cloud providers.</li> <li>Cost allocation and unit economics fluency: demonstrated ability to build or mature cost allocation frameworks that attribute shared infrastructure spend to products or customers in support of gross margin analysis.</li> <li>Data analysis skills: comfortable working with large, complex billing datasets and translating raw cost data into actionable insights; experience building BI dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools.</li> <li>Cross-functional influence: a track record of driving cost governance and cultural change across engineering and finance teams without direct authority, aligning engineers, finance partners, and senior leaders around shared cost accountability.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills: ability to present complex cost data clearly to both technical (infrastructure engineers, SREs) and non-technical (CFO, board) audiences.</li> <li>A demonstrated practice of integrating AI tools into your daily workflow to improve speed, quality, and decision-making.</li> <li>Fluency with AI across core tasks — research, drafting, analysis, planning — used as a default, not an exception.</li> <li>FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) or higher (e.g., FinOps Certified Professional) strongly preferred; cloud platform certifications (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and familiarity with the FinOps for AI framework are a plus.</li> <li>Experience building or maturing a FinOps practice is a significant differentiator; we are looking for someone comfortable operating in ambiguity, excited to define what great FinOps looks like at Cockroach Labs, and forward-thinking enough to extend cost governance into emerging areas like AI and machine learning infrastructure.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Team</strong></h2> <p>This role reports to Colin Minihan, Director of R&D Operations, and sits within the R&D Operations organization. You will work in close partnership with Finance and Cloud Engineering, serving as the connective layer between infrastructure cost reality and financial planning and reporting.</p> <p>Colin is responsible for ensuring that operations within the R&D department are as efficient and impactful as possible. He has built and managed multiple high-performing program management organizations at various companies, often during crucial growth stages. His love of learning and building extends beyond his profession in software, always looking for the next DIY project or outdoor hobby in the Pacific Northwest.</p> <hr> <p>Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at <a href="mailto:accessibility@cockroachlabs.com">accessibility@cockroachlabs.com</a>.</p> <p>Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.</p> <hr> <h1>Benefits</h1> <ul> <li>Medical Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Time Off</li> <li>Paid Parental Leave</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing Benefits</li> <li>Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Wellness Allowance</li> <li>Food Allowance </li> <li>Office Commute Reimbursement</li> <li>And more!</li> </ul> </div> </div>
